Requirement: The platform shall notify governed equipment costing records and decisions for ownership cost, operating cost, internal rates, fuel, maintenance, depreciation, and project chargeback, with tenant isolation, role-based access, effective dating, audit history, configurable approvals, and API availability.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an authorized user or integration, when the equipment costing transaction is submitted, then required fields and policies are validated, the state transition is recorded, financial and project links are preserved, exceptions are surfaced, and an immutable audit event is created.
